About RISE

A youth-led, community-based network in the Rohingya refugee camps of Cox’s Bazar.

Who We Are

RISE Refugee Initiative (RRI)

RISE Refugee Initiative (RRI) is a youth-led, community-based network based in Camp 8W, Balukhali, Ukhiya, Cox’s Bazar. We bring Rohingya youth together to learn, lead and take action for their communities.


Our work spans 12 core focus areas, including education, youth leadership, gender justice, child protection, health, climate resilience, livelihoods, creative expression, Rohingya culture and heritage, human rights and peace, digital empowerment, and community development.

Our Mission

To empower Rohingya youth to participate, be heard, and shape their own future.

Through leadership, education, advocacy, and storytelling, we turn voice into action.

Our Vision

A generation of Rohingya youth who lead, speak, and shape their own future.

A community where every young person stands at the centre, not the margins.

“Our voices are our strength, our unity is our power, and our youths are the force for changes.”

SAYEDUR RAHMAN · FOUNDER & EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR
Our Values

What guides us

Six values shape everything we do.

Refugee-led

We are from this community, for this community: our leadership is the point, not a symbol.

Voice

We tell our own stories, in our own words, through poetry, art, and creative expression.

Resilience

We build with what we have, where we are, and we do not wait for permission.

Education

We believe learning is the foundation of dignity, opportunity, and freedom.

Inclusion

Every young person, every gender, every camp, deserves a seat at the table.

Community

We stand with our people, across all camps, abroad, and in the diaspora, and alongside our neighbours.

Our 12 Core Focus Areas

How RISE Refugee Initiative works with refugee youth and communities.

📚
Focus 01

Education & Lifelong Learning

Learning support, literacy, English, STEM, reading clubs, scholarships, education campaigns, teacher/volunteer development, career guidance

🌱
Focus 02

Youth Leadership & Empowerment

Youth clubs, leadership training, volunteering, public speaking, debate, mentoring, youth-led community projects and civic participation

⚖️
Focus 03

Gender Justice, Women & Girls’ Empowerment

Gender equality, girls’ leadership, women’s participation, GBV prevention awareness, women’s skills, inclusion and safe spaces

🛡️
Focus 04

Child Protection & Safeguarding

Child rights, child safeguarding, prevention of child marriage and child labour, safe activities, protection awareness and referral information

🩺
Focus 05

Health, Hygiene, WASH & Nutrition

Health education, hygiene, menstrual health, sanitation, clean-water awareness, nutrition, first aid, disease prevention and referrals

🌍
Focus 06

Climate Action, Environment & Disaster Resilience

Climate education, waste management, recycling, environmental campaigns, fire prevention, cyclone preparedness, landslide awareness and disaster-risk reduction

💼
Focus 07

Skills Development, Livelihoods & Entrepreneurship

Vocational and digital skills, financial literacy, entrepreneurship, career readiness, freelancing awareness and income-generating skills

🎨
Focus 08

Arts, Poetry, Storytelling & Creative Expression

Poetry, creative writing, storytelling, drawing, painting, music, drama, photography, filmmaking, spoken word, exhibitions, publications and oral-history documentation

🕌
Focus 09

Rohingya Culture, Language, Heritage & Identity

Rohingya language, literature, traditions, oral history, cultural documentation, heritage activities, cultural events and intergenerational knowledge sharing

🕊️
Focus 10

Human Rights, Peace, Protection & Social Cohesion

Human-rights education, peacebuilding, conflict resolution, community dialogue, violence prevention, inclusion and refugee-host community activities

💻
Focus 11

Digital Empowerment, Media & Information

Computer literacy, digital safety, responsible social media, misinformation awareness, AI literacy, online learning, digital storytelling and youth media

🤝
Focus 12

Community Development, Research, Advocacy & Partnerships

Community assessments, research, documentation, advocacy, campaigns, monitoring, networking, partnerships and evidence-based community development

Questions

Good to know

Can I donate from outside Bangladesh?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp or email and we will share the international transfer options.

Will I know how my donation was used?

Yes. Send us your receipt and we will confirm it and share proof and updates with you.

Can I choose what my donation supports?

Yes. Choose textbooks, orphan support or yearly school support, or give any amount where it is needed most.

How can I be sure this is genuine?

Only use the bKash number and WhatsApp number shown on this page, and contact us at riseri.org@outlook.com if you are unsure.
